segments.en: Buy a bigger server, or buy more servers? Then decide who gets each request.
segments.zh: 買一台更大的伺服器，還是買更多台？然後決定每個請求交給誰。

segments.en: EncoreOne server ran Encore just fine, until the reunion tour went on sale. Dee has two options: scale up (a bigger machine) or scale out (more machines behind a load balancer). Try both, then pull the plug on one.
segments.zh: Encore一台伺服器撐 Encore 撐得好好的，直到重聚巡演開賣。Dee 有兩個選擇：向上擴展（換一台更大的機器），或向外擴展（在負載平衡器後面放更多台）。兩種都試試，然後拔掉其中一台的插頭。

試試看
向上擴展（垂直）

segments.en: One bigger machine. No code changes and nothing to coordinate. But there's a largest machine you can buy, upgrading usually means downtime, and when it dies, everything dies with it.
segments.zh: 一台更大的機器。不用改程式，也不用協調。但能買到的機器有上限，升級通常意味著停機，而且它一掛，所有東西跟著掛。
向外擴展（水平）

segments.en: More machines behind a load balancer. Grows almost without limit and survives losing a machine. But the app must not keep important state in one server's memory, since the next request may land elsewhere.
segments.zh: 在負載平衡器（load balancer）後面放更多台機器。幾乎可以無限成長，也撐得過壞掉一台。但 App 不能把重要狀態存在某一台伺服器的記憶體裡，因為下一個請求可能會落到別台。
關鍵差別

segments.en: Scaling up makes one server stronger. Scaling out adds servers and needs a load balancer to split the traffic. How it splits matters: least connections notices a server stuck on slow requests, while round robin keeps sending it more.
segments.zh: 向上擴展讓一台伺服器變強。向外擴展增加伺服器數量，需要負載平衡器來分配流量。怎麼分配很重要：最少連線會注意到卡在慢請求上的伺服器，輪詢則會繼續塞更多給它。

更強
垂直擴展

segments.en: A bigger machine. Easiest first step, with a hard ceiling and a single point of failure.
segments.zh: 一台更大的機器。最簡單的第一步，但有硬性上限，也是單點故障。
更多
水平擴展

segments.en: More machines. Survives failures and keeps growing, as long as servers are interchangeable (stateless).
segments.zh: 更多台機器。撐得過故障，也能持續成長，前提是伺服器彼此可以互換（無狀態）。
交通指揮
負載平衡器

segments.en: Splits requests across servers, skips dead ones, and picks a strategy: round robin, least connections, and others.
segments.zh: 把請求分配到各台伺服器、跳過掛掉的伺服器，並選擇一種策略：輪詢、最少連線等等。
取捨

segments.en: Scaling up is simple until it isn't. Scaling out costs some design work (shared sessions, a shared database) but removes the ceiling and the single point of failure. Most teams start up and move out.
segments.zh: 向上擴展很簡單，直到它不再簡單。向外擴展需要一些設計工作（共用工作階段、共用資料庫），但能去掉天花板和單點故障。大多數團隊會先向上，再向外。
考考自己

segments.en: 'Press Play on a normal day (30 requests/s, 1 medium server).'
segments.zh: '在平常日（每秒 30 個請求、1 台 medium 伺服器）按播放。'

segments.en: 'Plenty of headroom. Every request is served quickly.'
segments.zh: '餘裕很多，每個請求都很快就被處理。'
'按下開賣尖峰（每秒 150 個）。'

segments.en: 'The server\'s line fills up. Requests wait, then get 503 errors.'
segments.zh: '伺服器的隊伍滿了。請求先是等待，接著收到 503 錯誤。'

segments.en: 'Scale up: click “Bigger machine” until one server keeps up.'
segments.zh: '向上擴展：一直按「換更大的機器」，直到一台伺服器撐得住。'

segments.en: 'It works, but there\'s no bigger machine after x-large.'
segments.zh: '有效，但 x-large 之後就沒有更大的機器了。'
'現在把那台伺服器關掉。'

segments.en: 'One machine means one point of failure. Everything is down.'
segments.zh: '只有一台機器，就是單點故障。整個服務都掛了。'

segments.en: 'Scale out instead: add medium servers until the spike is handled.'
segments.zh: '改成向外擴展：一直加 medium 伺服器，直到撐住尖峰。'

segments.en: 'The load balancer spreads the work. Each medium server handles about 70 requests/s.'
segments.zh: '負載平衡器把工作分散開來。每台 medium 伺服器大約能處理每秒 70 個請求。'
'再加一台，然後關掉其中一台。'

segments.en: 'The load balancer stops sending to it. Only the requests already in its line fail, and the site stays up.'
segments.zh: '負載平衡器不再把請求送給它。只有已經在它隊伍裡的請求會失敗，網站依然正常。'

segments.en: 'With the spike running, compare Round robin and Least connections.'
segments.zh: '尖峰持續時，比較輪詢和最少連線。'

segments.en: 'Look at the P95 and at each server\'s line. Round robin keeps feeding a server that got stuck with checkouts.'
segments.zh: '看 P95 和每台伺服器的隊伍。輪詢會持續餵給一台卡在結帳請求上的伺服器。'
'已停機'
'超載'
'忙碌'
'正常'

segments.en:
`
app-${sv.id}${state[0]}
${SIZES[sv.size].name} · ~${reqCap(cap)} req/s
line: ${sv.alive ? lineLen : '–'}
`
segments.zh:
`
app-${sv.id}${state[0]}
${SIZES[sv.size].name} · 約 ${reqCap(cap)} 請求/秒
隊伍：${sv.alive ? lineLen : '–'}
`
`${S.servers.length} 台中有 ${m.alive} 台運作中`
' 毫秒'
'⬆ 已經是最大的機器'
'⬆ 換更大的機器（向上擴展）'
'按「播放」開始送出流量。'

segments.en: '✕ Total outage: no servers are left. Every request fails.'
segments.zh: '✕ 全面停擺：一台伺服器都不剩，每個請求都失敗。'

segments.en: `✕ Overloaded: ${S.rate} requests/s against roughly ${m.cap}/s of capacity. ${m.err} requests got a 503 in the last 3 s.`
segments.zh: `✕ 超載：每秒 ${S.rate} 個請求，容量卻只有約每秒 ${m.cap} 個。最近 3 秒有 ${m.err} 個請求收到 503。`

segments.en: `⚠ Keeping up, but lines are forming. P95 is ${X.fmt(m.p95)} ms.`
segments.zh: `⚠ 撐得住，但隊伍開始形成。P95 為 ${X.fmt(m.p95)} 毫秒。`
`✓ 健康：${m.alive} 台伺服器，P95 ${X.fmt(m.p95)} 毫秒。`
'輪詢（Round robin）'
'最少連線（Least connections）'
'隨機'
'伺服器群組'

segments.en: 'A named group of interchangeable app servers. Scaling out means adding a line to it (or letting autoscaling do it for you).'
segments.zh: '一組具名、可互換的應用伺服器。向外擴展就是在這裡多加一行（或交給自動擴展幫你做）。'
'平衡演算法'

segments.en: 'Leave this line out and nginx uses round robin. least_conn sends each request to the server with the fewest active requests. That\'s the lab\'s “Least connections”.'
segments.zh: '拿掉這一行，nginx 就會使用輪詢。least_conn 會把每個請求送給目前進行中請求最少的伺服器，也就是實驗室裡的「最少連線」。'
'伺服器'

segments.en: 'Each line is one app server, like the boxes in the lab. They must be interchangeable: same code, no important state kept in local memory.'
segments.zh: '每一行是一台應用伺服器，就像實驗室裡的方框。它們必須可以互換：同樣的程式碼，不在本機記憶體裡保存重要狀態。'
'跳過掛掉的伺服器'

segments.en: 'After 3 failures, nginx stops sending traffic to this server for 10 s. That\'s why killing one server only cost the requests already waiting in its line.'
segments.zh: '失敗 3 次後，nginx 會在 10 秒內停止把流量送給這台伺服器。這就是為什麼關掉一台伺服器時，只損失了已經在它隊伍裡等的請求。'
'唯一的大門'

segments.en: 'Fans connect to the load balancer, never to an app server directly. That\'s what lets you add and remove servers without anyone noticing.'
segments.zh: '歌迷連線到負載平衡器，從來不會直接連到應用伺服器。這讓你可以增減伺服器而沒有人察覺。'
'轉送'

segments.en: 'Pass each request to a server picked from the upstream group.'
segments.zh: '把每個請求轉給從 upstream 群組中挑出的一台伺服器。'
'換一台試試'

segments.en: 'If the chosen server errors or times out, retry the request on a different one. Only safe for requests that can be repeated (see Idempotency, page 10).'
segments.zh: '如果選中的伺服器出錯或逾時，就把請求改送到另一台重試。只對可以重複執行的請求才安全（見第 10 頁〈冪等性〉）。'

segments.en: 'Encore runs on the largest machine the cloud provider sells, and it\'s at 95% CPU during on-sales. What now?'
segments.zh: 'Encore 已經跑在雲端供應商賣的最大機器上，開賣時 CPU 還是到 95%。現在怎麼辦？'
'升級成更大的機器'

segments.en: 'There isn\'t one. That\'s the ceiling of vertical scaling.'
segments.zh: '沒有更大的了。這就是垂直擴展的天花板。'

segments.en: 'Scale out: run several servers behind a load balancer'
segments.zh: '向外擴展：在負載平衡器後面跑好幾台伺服器'

segments.en: 'Horizontal scaling has no single-machine ceiling, and it removes the single point of failure.'
segments.zh: '水平擴展沒有單一機器的天花板，也去掉了單點故障。'
'更常重開伺服器'

segments.en: 'Restarting doesn\'t add capacity. It just causes short outages.'
segments.zh: '重開不會增加容量，只會造成短暫停機。'

segments.en: 'After scaling out to 3 servers, fans get logged out at random. Why?'
segments.zh: '向外擴展到 3 台伺服器之後，歌迷會隨機被登出。為什麼？'
'負載平衡器壞了'

segments.en: 'It\'s doing its job: spreading requests across servers.'
segments.zh: '它正在做它該做的事：把請求分散到各台伺服器。'

segments.en: 'Sessions are stored in one server\'s memory, so the next request lands on a server that doesn\'t know the fan'
segments.zh: '工作階段存在某一台伺服器的記憶體裡，所以下一個請求落到一台不認得這位歌迷的伺服器'

segments.en: 'Horizontal scaling needs stateless servers. Move sessions to a shared store (Redis, the database, or signed cookies).'
segments.zh: '水平擴展需要無狀態的伺服器。把工作階段移到共用的儲存空間（Redis、資料庫或簽章過的 cookie）。'
'3 台伺服器是不吉利的數字'

segments.en: 'Any number above one has the same problem while state lives in local memory.'
segments.zh: '只要狀態存在本機記憶體裡，任何超過一台的數量都有同樣的問題。'

segments.en: 'One server keeps getting stuck on slow checkout requests while the others sit idle. Which balancing setting helps most?'
segments.zh: '有一台伺服器一直卡在慢速的結帳請求上，其他台卻閒著。哪一種平衡設定最有幫助？'

segments.en: 'Round robin hands out requests in turn, no matter how busy each server is.'
segments.zh: '輪詢會依序分配請求，不管每台伺服器有多忙。'

segments.en: 'It sends new requests to the server with the fewest active ones, so a server stuck on slow work gets fewer new requests.'
segments.zh: '它會把新請求送給進行中請求最少的伺服器，所以卡在慢工作上的伺服器會收到比較少的新請求。'

segments.en: 'Sending every request to the first server'
segments.zh: '把每個請求都送給第一台伺服器'

segments.en: 'That turns your three servers back into one.'
segments.zh: '這等於把你的三台伺服器又變回一台。'
